def click(r,c,label):
    before = current_frame.ascii
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    c2 = current_frame.ascii
    diffs = [(i,j,cb,cc) for i,(rb,rc) in enumerate(zip(before.split('\n'),c2.split('\n'))) for j,(cb,cc) in enumerate(zip(rb,rc)) if cb!=cc]
    non = [d for d in diffs if d[0]!=1]
    print(label, non[:6] if non else 'only-timer')
